findings.claim: evidence.json for round1 (B) is not, and should not be read as, the row-by-row verdict record for tickets/map-I0..I3.md and map-P0..P3.md.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/review/out/r4/B/round1/review/evidence.json is 2591 bytes and contains exactly one finding (id evidence-1) plus one re-verified claim; grep -c '^|' over tickets/map-I0.md, map-I1.md, map-I2.md, map-I3.md, map-P0.md, map-P1.md, map-P2.md, map-P3.md gives 46+46+46+43+47+47+47+45 = 367 table rows total, and grep -l 'map-I|map-P' over every evidence.json under docs/v2/review/out/r4/ (A/round1, A/round2, B/round1) returns no matches. The 367 rows are not individually verdicted inside any evidence.json. They ARE covered elsewhere: ISSUE-OUTCOMES-r4.md references map-I/map-P 105 times, so a row-by-row verdict pass did happen, just not in this file.
findings.fix: No doc fix needed. Record for the synthesis step: when checking 'did every map row get a verdict', read ISSUE-OUTCOMES-r4.md, not evidence.json; evidence.json's small size (2591 B) is expected and not itself a gap, since it is a targeted re-open file, not the issue-map ledger.
